_provenance: Hand-authored by visually reviewing extracted frames (see docs/designs/activity-detection-baseline.md data-sourcing plan and report.md). vtest.avi is OpenCV's public-domain samples/data/vtest.avi (BSD-licensed project sample), an unmodified overhead courtyard/walkway clip — not staged for this assignment. Segment boundaries were chosen independently from the pipeline's own predicted timestamps by inspecting frames at ~1-4s intervals and checking, by eye, when people are actually inside the taped-off area (Intrusion) or tightly clustered (Crowd Formation). This video does not naturally contain Loitering, Running, Falling, Abandoned Object, Fire/Smoke, Fighting, Vandalism, or Theft events, so those 8 classes have zero ground-truth segments here and are not quantitatively evaluated by this video — a real, disclosed limitation, not an evaluation gap that was overlooked.
